scripts.dev: npm run clean & npx vite & tsx server.ts
scripts.clean: (if exist dist rd /s /q dist) & (if exist node_modules\.vite rd /s /q node_modules\.vite) & (if exist *.log del /q *.log) & (if exist npm-debug.log* del /q npm-debug.log*) & (if exist yarn-debug.log* del /q yarn-debug.log*) & (if exist *.tmp del /q *.tmp) & (if exist *.temp del /q *.temp) & (if exist *.bak del /q *.bak) & (if exist *.backup del /q *.backup) & (if exist *.old del /q *.old) & (if exist pw-*.mjs del /q pw-*.mjs) & (if exist android\app\build rd /s /q android\app\build) & (if exist android\.gradle\buildOutputCleanup rd /s /q android\.gradle\buildOutputCleanup)
scripts.android: npm run clean && npm run build && npx capacitor sync && npx capacitor open android
scripts.android:release: npm run build && npx capacitor sync android
